Handwriting track

• Detail stroke order, pressure patterns and any indications of autopen, cut-and-paste or digital overlay.

1. A single, court-ready report (PDF) that merges findings from both tracks, written in plain language with technical appendices.

Acceptance criteria  
• Procedures must follow NIST/ISO 17025 or comparable guidelines, with tool output traceable (e.g., EnCase, FTK, X-Ways, Cellebrite where applicable).

• Crear, formatear y actualizar documentos en Word y hojas de cálculo en Excel según indicaciones.

title: Accurate Handwritten Notes to PDF
desc:
I’m digitising several batches of handwritten notes and need them reproduced faithfully, then supplied back to me as clean, professionally formatted PDFs. The handwriting is straightforward—no technical jargon, formulae, or specialised symbols—so the focus is squarely on accuracy, layout consistency, and an error-free final file.

Besides straight typing, some pages will require light copy-paste transfers and re-formatting so the text aligns smoothly across paragraphs, headings, and any listed items. On a few legacy files I may also ask you to convert existing PDFs into editable Word documents so I can make quick edits before we lock the final version back down to PDF.  

I will provide high-resolution scans, page counts, and any style guidelines up front. You commit to:  
• Flawless transcription with spelling and punctuation intact  
• Consistent margins, fonts, and heading hierarchy  
• Timely delivery of each agreed batch in PDF format  

If you spot ambiguities in the handwriting, flag them early so we can clarify and keep momentum. Finished files should open perfectly in Adobe Acrobat without extra optimisation steps on my end.

Let me know your turnaround time per 20 pages and any tools you prefer for OCR, proofreading, or PDF production. Accuracy and punctuality are my top priorities; if those match your working style, this should be a smooth ongoing collaboration.

title: Commission-Only Cold Callers
desc:
I build conversion-focused websites for local businesses of every niche and I’m ready to scale. To do that, I need energetic cold callers who are happy to work strictly on commission and who know how to open doors with business owners over the phone.

Your job is simple: track down local companies that still rely on outdated or poorly performing sites (or have none at all), spark their interest in upgrading, explain the value of our done-for-you website service, and close the sale. I can supply a proven script, case-study material and a lightweight CRM, or you can lean on your own tools if you already have a system that works.

Commission is paid on every deal you personally bring in, with no caps. You’ll log call notes in the CRM so we both stay transparent on pipeline progress and so payouts are easy to verify. If you have prior success selling digital services by phone and the confidence to earn purely from the deals you land, let’s talk—there’s no limit on how much you can make here. COMMISSION ONLY

title: Translate Mystery Novel to German
desc:
I have a full-length English-language mystery/thriller novel that needs to come alive for German readers. The book relies heavily on atmosphere, tension and a web of subtle clues, plus it contains many location-specific cultural references and idiomatic turns of phrase that must feel natural to a German audience rather than forced or literal.

Your task is to deliver a fluent, engaging German manuscript that preserves:

• the pacing and suspense integral to the genre  
• each character’s unique voice and dialogue rhythms  
• the intent behind culturally loaded references—adapted where necessary so the meaning lands for German readers while staying faithful to the original plot

Deliverables  
1. Complete German translation in an editable Word document, mirroring the original chapter structure  
2. Brief translator’s notes highlighting any significant cultural or idiomatic adaptations  
3. One revision pass after my review to polish any remaining nuances

Please share examples of previous literary or mystery/thriller translations you have handled and your estimated timeline for a project of this scope. I look forward to collaborating with someone who can capture every twist and cliff-hanger in pitch-perfect German.

title: Actor Commercial & Theatrical Headshots
desc:
I need fresh, professional headshots that work for both commercial and theatrical submissions. I’m flexible on lighting—natural, studio, or a thoughtful mix—so long as the final images look flattering and industry-ready. A clean, plain-color backdrop keeps the focus on expression, so please plan for that setup.

Shoot goals  
• Capture distinct looks tailored for commercial (approachable, friendly) and theatrical (dramatic, comedic, character-driven) casting.  
• Provide coaching during the session to bring out authentic expressions.  
• Deliver at least 6 fully retouched selects in both high-resolution print format and optimized web copies, plus all usable proofs.

I’ll handle wardrobe; you bring the technical expertise, camera gear, and lighting that best achieves the brief. Turnaround of proofs within 48 hours and finals within a week would be ideal.

title: Blue-Collar Lead Generation Setup
desc:
I’m launching a UK-wide lead generation agency that will feed a steady stream of qualified enquiries to plumbers, electricians and landscapers. I already know the service I want to offer—pure lead generation—so I now need an experienced specialist who can turn that idea into a functioning, revenue-producing operation.

Here’s what I have in mind:
• Shape the overall strategy: define the buyer personas for each trade, map their typical customer journey and recommend the mix of channels most likely to deliver predictable results.
• Build the engine: set up the campaigns, tracking, automations and reporting dashboards so we can attribute every call, form fill or booking back to its source.
• Produce proof fast: deliver an initial batch of real-world leads we can hand to our first trade clients to validate the funnel.
• Document everything: provide a concise playbook I can follow to scale the process to new trades and regions.

You’re free to lean on social media ads, Google search, local SEO snippets, email outreach—or anything else you trust—provided it complies with UK advertising rules and delivers measurable, cost-effective leads.

If you’ve built high-performing funnels for UK trades before and can show verifiable results, I want to hear how you’d tackle this brief, the tools you’d use and the timeline you’d need to get the first leads rolling in.

title: Remote Job Market Research Assistant
desc:
I’m looking for a Virtual Assistant to help with online research and organization of remote technology job opportunities.

The goal of this project is to collect and organize relevant job market information for software engineering roles, including AI, backend, full-stack, cloud, and DevOps positions.

Responsibilities:

Identify roles that match specific technical skills and experience requirements.
Record job details including company name, position title, location, technology stack, salary information (when available), and job link.
Organize collected information in Notion, Google Sheets, or a similar tracking system.
Categorize opportunities by role type, technology requirements, and relevance.
Provide regular updates on research progress.

Experience with web research and data organization.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to summarize job descriptions accurately.
Familiarity with technology roles is preferred.
Experience with Notion or Google Sheets is a plus.

Organized job research database.
Regular research updates.
Clearly categorized remote job opportunities.

title: Part-Time Multi-Field Assistant
desc:

Work may range from light administrative support to bits of customer interaction or simple graphic tweaks—whatever keeps the business moving smoothly that week. Because priorities shift, I value adaptability more than deep specialization; if you are comfortable learning on the fly and pick up new tools quickly, we’ll get along well.

Clear communication, dependable turnaround times, and good attention to detail are essential.

When you respond, let me know:
• Your time-zone and preferred working windows  
• Relevant software you already handle confidently

title: HR Assistant for Records & Payroll

title: KDP Guidance for Children’s Book

1. A step-by-step production plan tailored to my book.  
2. Polished, upload-ready files or proven formatting templates.

We can collaborate through recorded calls, shared docs in Google Drive, and screen-share walkthroughs inside KDP, Canva/InDesign, or any tools you recommend. If this sounds like work you’ve done for your own titles—or better yet, for other children’s authors—let’s talk details and schedule our first session.

title: Asistencia para empleo remoto

Busco apoyo integral para conseguir un trabajo de medio tiempo, 100 % remoto, en el área de atención al cliente. Ya cuento con experiencia previa atendiendo clientes; necesito ayuda para:

title: French Child Speech Consultant -- 2
desc:

All families you’ll meet are native French speakers, so every session—and all written feedback—must be in French.

Here’s how the collaboration works:

All development must be carried out in GX Works3, making full use of the motion instruction set and cam table utilities available for the iQ-F series. I already have the basic hardware topology and parameter files; what I need is a clean, well-structured program that:

• Generates and downloads the required rotational cam profiles.

• Handles start-up homing, cam engagement, on-the-fly ratio changes, and safe stop routines.  
• Includes concise comments and a short commissioning guide so I can adapt timings later.

Acceptance criteria: each slave axis must track the master within ±1 pulse at 2000 rpm when tested on a scope, and the project file must compile with no warnings in GX Works3.

Deliverables: GXW3 project file, exported cam tables (CSV or TXT), and a brief PDF explaining parameter settings, test procedure, and any user bits required for HMI control.

Where results form recognisable patterns (for example, anaemia profiles or inflammatory markers) the model should surface likely differential diagnoses and recommended next-step investigations.

To get there I will need robust OCR or direct-feed parsing, a well-trained ML/NLP pipeline (TensorFlow, PyTorch or similar), and a lightweight cross-platform front-end—web first, with mobile to follow. Clinical accuracy, privacy (HIPAA / GDPR), and clear audit trails for every prediction are non-negotiable.

Please send me a detailed project proposal covering architecture, data-set strategy, validation metrics, regulatory safeguards, timeline, and your past experience with comparable medical or regulated AI products.  

Acceptance criteria:

title: SW Maps Geospatial Reporting
desc:

desc:
I want a purpose-built Android auto-clicker that lets me freeze the falling gold coin in my tapping game and then fires taps at maximum speed on three points simultaneously. With the coin locked in place, the tap burst must reliably drive the in-game score to at least 500,000—and ideally 600,000—within 30 seconds.

Key expectations  
• Coin freeze trigger must work every run, without manual dexterity tricks.  
• Three-point tapping should begin instantly after the freeze and keep firing at the fastest rate the device can register, right through the 30-second window.  
• Stability is critical: no crashes, no missed taps, and no interference with other foreground apps while it runs.  
• Solution should install and launch cleanly on recent Android versions and remain lightweight enough not to bog down the OS.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Demonstrate a recorded gameplay session that reaches 5–6 lakh score in 30 seconds.  
2. Provide the compiled APK (or script package) plus clear setup instructions.  
3. Supply source code so I can retune timing if game updates change tap thresholds.  
4. App should pass at least one continuous one-hour stress test without crashing.

If you have questions about timing, touch injection methods, or device compatibility, feel free to ask—once these criteria are hit, I’m ready to sign off.

• College/partner panel so institutions can onboard their cohorts and monitor performance  
• Payment gateway integration for Indian and international methods  
• Automated certificate generation with tamper-proof QR-based verification  
• Scalable architecture that lets us later plug in company HR dashboards and new colleges with minimal rework

Must-have experience points: secure coding, responsive UI that feels professional and corporate, fast load times, role-based access control, cloud deployment, and database design ready for heavy growth.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Fully functional web platform plus cross-platform mobile app published to stores.  
2. Successful test transaction from registration to certificate issuance, QR pa

title: Animate PSD Mascot In Rive (Raster Animations)
desc:
I already have a layered PSD of our brand mascot and now need it brought to life in Rive. The art is final, so no illustration work is required—just animation.  

The first batch of motions I need are the core loops: idle, walking and talking. I will forward the PSD with every part on its own layer so you can rig the character inside Rive, set up bones, constraints and state machines, then export the animations ready for integration. A more detailed shot-list and naming convention will follow once we sign the agreement, but expect the scope to stay around those three key loops.  

Deliverables  
• Rive (.riv) file with organised artboards and state machine  
• Exported animations (GIF or MP4 previews) so the dev team can review quickly  
• Any additional texture atlases or assets required for implementation  

Acceptance criteria  
• Smooth, game-ready loops that play seamlessly on repeat  
• No visual drift or pixelation from the original PSD artwork  
• File size optimised for web and mobile use  

If you are comfortable animating raster artwork in Rive and can turn this around efficiently, let’s talk details and timing.

title: Cinematic Wedding Video Editing
desc:
I have raw footage from a recent wedding and need an editor who can transform it into a polished, cinematic-style film. The primary focus is the ceremony itself, so I want those key moments woven together with the pacing, colour grading, and emotive storytelling you’d expect from a feature-film trailer rather than a traditional recap.

I’ll supply the multi-camera files, ambient audio, and any reference notes you need via cloud transfer. Your task is to:

• Select the best ceremony angles and reactions  
• Sync and balance audio so vows are crystal-clear  
• Apply professional colour correction and grading for a cohesive, cinematic look  
• Add tasteful transitions, subtle motion graphics (titles, lower thirds), and licensed background music that matches the emotional tone  
• Deliver a high-quality 4K master and a web-optimised file ready for streaming

Experience with Premiere Pro or Final Cut, advanced colour tools such as DaVinci Resolve, and a solid portfolio of wedding or event films is important. I’m happy to answer any creative questions upfront so the first draft aligns with my vision, and I’ll provide prompt feedback to keep the revision loop efficient. Let’s create a stunning ceremony highlight film that the couple will treasure for years.

title: Instagram Engagement Marketing Support
desc:

Here’s what I’m after: a data-driven content and posting plan that sparks conversation in the comments, lifts saves and shares, and nudges my existing audience to interact more often. You’ll look over my current feed, audit recent performance, and then map out fresh creative concepts (reels, carousels, stories, captions, hashtags) backed by insights from Instagram Analytics or similar third-party tools.

Deliverables

Acceptance criteria
The plan should be clear enough for a non-marketer to implement, align with Instagram’s latest algorithm shifts, and show projected benchmarks for engagement lift within the first month.

If this sounds like the kind of challenge you excel at, let’s chat and get the campaign rolling.

Accuracy is critical—every character needs to match the original, and the final sheet should align perfectly with the template structure I provide. I’ll share a short style guide, sample entries, and clear naming conventions before you start so you can follow them from the very first record.

Deliverable  
• A completed spreadsheet populated with all records, fully validated against the original source files.  

I’ll review the file on submission, checking for correctness and consistency; once everything matches, the task is complete. If this sounds clear and doable, let’s move forward.

title: Artikel Ulasan Mobil Mendalam

• Dokumen teks siap tayang (Google Docs atau Word) beserta daftar referensi.
• Paragraf pembuka menarik, sub-judul terstruktur, dan ringkasan kesimpulan yang jelas.

Jika Anda berpengalaman menulis ulasan performa kendaraan, silakan jelaskan contoh pekerjaan serupa saat mengajukan.

title: Edit Video TikTok Sederhana -- 2
desc:
Saya membutuhkan bantuan untuk mengedit beberapa video pendek agar siap tayang di TikTok. Materi mentah berdurasi 15–30 detik sudah saya siapkan; tugas Anda hanya merapikan, meng‐cut bagian tak perlu, menambah teks singkat, efek transition ringan, serta backsound bebas copyright yang cocok dengan mood konten.  

Rincian pekerjaan:  
• Terima file raw (format MP4 atau MOV, resolusi 1080×1920).  
• Potong, susun, dan sinkronkan klip agar alur tetap cepat dan menarik.  
• Tambahkan subtitle burn-in sederhana dan stiker basic jika relevan.  
• Sesuaikan warna/brightness seperlunya agar video tetap cerah di layar ponsel.  
• Ekspor final ke rasio 9:16, maksimal 60 MB, siap upload ke TikTok.  

Saya lebih mengutamakan proses yang praktis—bila Anda memakai CapCut, VN, Adobe Premiere Rush, atau tool mobile lain, silakan; yang penting hasilnya bersih dan file mudah saya terima lewat Google Drive.  

Berikan contoh singkat hasil edit serupa bila ada. Saya pemula, jadi saya butuh penjelasan langkah sederhana agar ke depan saya dapat merevisi sendiri. Terima kasih!

title: Pengembangan Game Beriklan untuk Penghasilan
desc:
Saya ingin membangun sebuah aplikasi penghasil uang berbentuk game hiburan. Target utama saya adalah memonetisasi melalui iklan dalam aplikasi—mulai dari banner, interstitial, hingga rewarded video.  

Yang saya butuhkan:  
• Konsep game kasual yang cepat dipelajari namun membuat pengguna betah bermain.  
• Rekomendasi dan integrasi jaringan iklan terbaik (AdMob, Unity Ads, atau opsi setara) berikut pengaturan eCPM dan penjadwalan tayang iklan yang optimal.  
• Implementasi kode sumber (Android Studio / Unity) lengkap dengan dokumentasi sehingga saya dapat memperbarui konten di kemudian hari.  
• Dasbor analitik terpadu (Firebase, Google Analytics, atau serupa) untuk melacak retensi pemain dan pendapatan harian.  
• Panduan singkat cara merilis ke Google Play serta tips ASO agar aplikasi cepat mendapatkan unduhan organik.  

Proyek akan dinilai selesai ketika:  
1. Game dapat di-build tanpa error di lingkungan pengembangan yang disepakati.  
2. Iklan tampil sesuai skenario dan mencatat impresi di dasbor.  
3. Semua file sumber, aset, dan dokumentasi diserahkan.  

Jika Anda sudah pernah meluncurkan game beriklan sebelumnya, sertakan tautan portofolio atau contoh pendapatan ads (jika memungkinkan). Saya terbuka pada ide tambahan yang dapat meningkatkan engagement atau ARPDAU.

title: Launch My Informative YouTube Channel
desc:
I’m ready to build a fresh YouTube presence that delivers clear, knowledgeable, and genuinely informative videos for both adults and teens. I already have my subject-matter mapped out; what I need is your expertise to turn those ideas into a polished channel that viewers can find, trust, and subscribe to.

If you have extra tricks—end-screen strategies, Shorts repurposing, or community post tactics—feel free to suggest them. My main goal is to launch confidently with a fully configured, discoverable channel and the knowledge to maintain it. Let’s get started!

title: Vissim Detailed Traffic Model Configuration
desc:
I have a corridor already laid out in Vissim and now need every operational detail brought to life. All signal heads, conflict areas, must be fully coded so the model runs exactly as my Synchro-based timing plans intend.

Here is what I will hand over at the start:
• The current Synchro *.syn file (with timing sheets and phase diagrams)
• The RBCs exported from Synchro
• The base Vissim network geometry

Your task is to take those inputs and:
• Insert and configure all signal heads, assigning the correct timing and phases from my Synchro file.
• Build out every conflict area.

Acceptance criteria
1. The completed .inpx file opens with no errors or missing objects.
2. Signal groups display the exact timings and phase sequences found in the Synchro printout.
3. Vehicle interactions in each conflict area match the defined zone type and flow pattern

If you are confident working in PTV Vissim, and can read Synchro outputs quickly, I’m ready to share the files and move ahead.

Please note that I am not responsible for Vissim Licenses.

title: Minimalist Non-Fiction Print Book Layout
desc:
I’m ready to take my completed non-fiction manuscript into production and need an experienced book designer to create a clean, minimalist interior for print. The focus is on readability and a modern, uncluttered aesthetic: generous white space, consistent hierarchy for headings and sub-headings, and elegant treatment of any pull-quotes, tables, or footnotes that appear.

You’ll handle full interior layout from title page through back matter, supply a press-ready PDF that meets standard printer specs (bleeds, margins, embedded fonts), and include the working file—Adobe InDesign is ideal—so I can update it later if needed. Pagination must align perfectly and all text styles should be properly linked to paragraph/character styles for easy global edits.

If you’ve produced minimalist print editions before, please share samples along with your estimated timeline. I’m looking to move quickly once we agree on the scope and will be available for prompt feedback throughout the process.

title: Hungarian Court Document Translation
desc:
I need several English-language court documents rendered into flawless Hungarian. Legal terminology must be translated with absolute precision, headings and numbering mirrored exactly, and the final file formatted so it can be submitted to the court without additional editing.  

Because these are official pleadings, confidentiality is paramount. If you are a certified or sworn translator in Hungary and can supply a translator’s declaration or notarised statement, please note that in your bid; it will be a strong advantage.  

You will receive the originals in Word and PDF and I’d like the finished work back in both editable Word and print-ready PDF.  
Accuracy, consistency, and on-time delivery are the only success criteria—if the translated text reads as though it was drafted natively in Hungarian legal style, the job is done.

title: Phone Survey Specialist Needed
desc:
We are an early-stage robotics company in the Houston-area company developing technology that automatically finds and treats pests on large properties.

Project overview
We need a caller to survey fewer than 30 leads — golf courses, sod and turf farms, sports complexes, and pest control companies — and offer a free on-site property scan. The goal is to understand current pest-management practices and book site-visit appointments with interested contacts. The appointments are free. We will scan the property and share the results with the interested party.

Call each lead on the provided list at various times of day. Once you reach the person responsible for grounds, follow the provided script with about 10 survey questions; calls should take roughly 5-10 minutes. Offer a free on-site scan and collect appointment details: contact name, phone, email, property address, and preferred days and times.
Log every call, outcome, survey response, and detailed note in Zoho CRM.
Log unreachable leads, including attempt count and any voicemails left.


Requirements
The work requires cold-calling, phone-survey, or appointment-setting experience; clear, friendly English; comfort speaking with grounds managers, farm owners, and small business owners; accurate note-taking; availability during US Central Time business hours; and US-based location. The phone style should be relaxed and friendly, with room for the light humor in our script.

title: Reverse Engineering Security Pen Test
desc:
I want a specialist to pull my compiled application apart and probe it as an attacker would, using reverse-engineering techniques to carry out a full penetration test. The main objective is to confirm whether the code, protocols and storage layers can be abused, bypassed or repurposed in ways I did not intend.

Focus areas  
• Authentication issues  
• Data breaches  
• Malware injection  

Typical tooling might include IDA Pro, Ghidra, x64dbg, Burp Suite and custom scripts—use whatever combination you find most effective, so long as the final artefacts are reproducible on my end.

Deliverables  
• A step-by-step technical report that maps the attack surface, documents every exploit attempt (successful or not) and ranks the risks  
• Proof-of-concept files or scripts demonstrating each confirmed weakness  
• Clear remediation guidance for every finding, prioritised by severity  
• A short debrief call or recorded walkthrough to clarify results and next steps

I will supply the latest build, any required test credentials and clarification on expected user flows. Let me know how you prefer to handle milestones and NDA, and I’ll set those up right away.

Let me know your expected turnaround time and any quality-control steps you use to minimize transcription errors.

• Capture enough variety for multiple Reels plus a handful of still or short clips for static posts  
• Deliver the raw clips (or edited files if you take on post-production) within 48 hours of each session via Google Drive or AirDrop  

We can arrange one or two half-day sessions depending on your availability. Let me know your earliest slot within the coming fortnight, the kit you can bring, and links to any social-first video work you’ve shot on a phone.

title: Classroom Crisis Journalism Simulation
desc:
I'm seeking experienced journalists to support a classroom simulation focused on public communication strategies during a public health emergency. 

The Scenario
The simulation begins during an extreme heat event that is placing unusual strain on the regional electrical grid. The new, AI-ready data-center campus remains online, but nearby communities begin experiencing rolling outages. As conditions deteriorate, a residential district loses air conditioning, water pressure falls, local businesses lose refrigerated inventory, and a neighborhood health clinic begins transferring patients and temperature-sensitive medicines as its backup systems weaken. Several residents require treatment for heat-related illness. The facts are incomplete. It is unclear whether the data center, the regional utility, automated load-management systems, operating constraints, or a combination of factors contributed to the severity of the disruption. Nevertheless, a compelling public narrative spreads rapidly: “The data center stayed online while our community went dark.” Leaders must act before technical certainty is available.

Ideal Skills & Experience:
- Background in journalism or crisis communication
- Experience in educational program development
- Ability to ask pointed/challenging questions to develop the learning experience for participants
- Tech/Investigative background

Looking for journalists who can attend in person, from 11am to 2:30pm on Friday, October 2, 2026 in Los Angeles, CA

Review and optimise the schematics of the four boards, and close the component values and packages that SFI has left marked as open.
Verify and strengthen input protection against the stated target of IEC 61000-4-x Level 4: ESD, surge and EFT; galvanic isolation on RS-485; reverse polarity and overcurrent.

I have a set of scanned copies of paper documents that contain both text and numerical fields. I need every character—words, figures, dates, codes—typed with absolute accuracy into a digital format of my choosing (most likely an Excel sheet or Google Sheet, though I’m open to your suggestion if you have a more efficient workflow).  

Because the material is mixed data coming from images, close attention to detail is essential. Mis-keyed digits or misspelled names will break downstream reports, so double-checking your own work before handing it back is vital. A familiarity with basic data-cleaning functions such as text-to-columns, simple formulas, or validation rules will help you spot issues quickly, but the main task is straightforward typing and verification.

Deliverable:  
• One well-structured spreadsheet (Excel, CSV, or Google Sheet) mirroring the layout of the originals, with all text and numeric fields correctly transcribed.

Please let me know how soon you can begin, roughly how many pages you can process per day, and any tools (OCR, spreadsheet add-ins, etc.) you prefer to use. Accuracy comes first; speed is second.

title: Recupero Account Instagram Compromesso
desc:

Ho già aperto diverse segnalazioni a Instagram ma, nonostante i tentativi, il sistema automatico continua a respingere la procedura di recupero. Non dispongo di un documento di identità precedentemente collegato all’account, perciò i canali standard non stanno funzionando.  

Mi serve un professionista che conosca a fondo le policy Meta, i form di contatto avanzati e le best-practice per il recupero di account compromessi, così da riconquistare l’accesso e poter tornare a seguire i miei contatti. Approcci non conformi ai Termini di Servizio non mi interessano: cerco un intervento lecito e tracciabile, eventualmente includendo la compilazione corretta dei moduli, la gestione di ticket di supporto e la preparazione di prove d’identità alternative (video selfie, metadati, ecc.).  

Deliverable essenziali:  
• Accesso ripristinato all’account (login funzionante)  
• Breve report con i passaggi eseguiti e indicazioni su come prevenire futuri attacchi  

Accetto la suddivisione del lavoro in milestone allineate ai vari step (es. apertura form, risposta di Meta, verifica finale).

title: Travel Blog Post Writer Needed
desc:

Beyond solid storytelling, I value factual accuracy, clear structure, and SEO-conscious phrasing that feels natural to human readers. You’ll be free to recommend destinations or angles (cultural insights, itinerary ideas, cost breakdowns, etc.) as long as the focus remains squarely on travel.

Deliverables

• Compelling headlines, sub-headings, and meta descriptions for each piece  
• At least three high-quality, royalty-free image suggestions per article with proper attribution  

Acceptance Criteria
• Formal tone maintained throughout  
• Logical flow with strong introductions, informative body sections, and clear conclusions  
• Keyword integration that reads naturally and avoids over-optimization  
• Ready-to-publish formatting in either Google Docs or Word  

If you have a portfolio of similar work, share the links so I can gauge your voice and depth of research. Looking forward to collaborating and showcasing memorable destinations together.

title: Setup Gmail Bisnis Klien
desc:

• Membuat struktur domain dan pengguna sehingga saya dapat membuat serta mengelola alamat-alamat email klien secara terpisah dan aman.  
• Menyiapkan template email profesional yang mudah saya sesuaikan untuk berbagai kebutuhan klien—newsletter, penawaran, dan pemberitahuan layanan.  
• Mengintegrasikan Gmail Bisnis dengan satu sistem manajemen proyek yang sudah kami gunakan agar pesan otomatis tercatat sebagai tugas, komentar, atau notifikasi di platform tersebut.

3. Alur integrasi aktif antara Gmail dan sistem manajemen proyek (mis. melalui Zapier, API, atau add-on resmi) beserta dokumentasi cara menambah klien baru ke alur tersebut.

title: Marketing Email Translation
desc:

The tone must stay persuasive and friendly, CTAs must remain clear, and any idioms should feel natural to readers in the new language.

I will review each piece for accuracy, consistency with brand voice, and proper formatting for email templates. Please let me know your experience with marketing-focused translation and how quickly you can turn around the first draft.

title: Narrative YouTube Product Review Editor
desc:
I turn raw footage of my product reviews into short YouTube stories, each running under five minutes, and I’m looking for an editor who can shape that material into an engaging, narrative-driven experience. Rather than a rapid-fire montage, I want a clear beginning, middle, and end that hooks viewers, walks them through benefits, and closes with a confident call-to-action.

What you’ll handle  
• Select and arrange A-roll and B-roll so the story flows naturally  
• Add unobtrusive motion graphics, on-screen text, and royalty-free music that enhance—never distract  
• Perform colour correction, audio levelling, and light noise reduction  
• Export final files in 4K and 1080p, plus an SRT caption track

I’ll provide multi-cam footage, product shots, a loose script, and reference timestamps via Google Drive; you return the first cut within three days and include up to two revision rounds.

Acceptance criteria  
• Runtime about 4½ minutes (±30 s)  
• Smooth narrative arc without jarring jump cuts  
• Clean audio peaking below –1 dBFS, LUFS ≈ –14  
• Final files ready for direct upload to YouTube

If you have examples of similarly crafted product reviews that show strong storytelling, please share two links so I can get a feel for your style.

title: Fast-Paced Product Demo Edits -- 2
desc:
I need my raw product-demo footage turned into sharp, scroll-stopping videos that match the high-energy feel of our brand. Expect quick cuts, punchy motion graphics, rhythmic sound design, and captions that keep viewers hooked even with the sound off.

Source assets will arrive in 4K (MP4 and ProRes). You’ll trim, colour-grade, stabilise when needed, add branded lower thirds, bumpers, a music bed I’ll supply, and export final masters in 1080p and vertical 9:16 for socials. Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve is fine—just maintain the fast-paced, energetic style chosen.

Deliverables
• 3 fully edited product-demo videos (30–60 sec each)

Acceptance criteria
• Edits feel dynamic without sacrificing clarity of the product features

• Audio peaks below –1 dB; loudness around –14 LUFS

If you excel at eye-catching, high-tempo storytelling for product demos, let’s get started.

title: Compile GST Refund Claim Data
desc:
I need a clean, audit-ready data pack to support an inverted duty structure refund claim under GST. All of the raw information already sits inside Tally; what’s missing is a well-organised export of every Purchase Order, Sales Invoice and Tax Payment Receipt for the chosen tax period, matched and reconciled so it can be uploaded with the RFD application.

You will have remote access to Tally (or can guide me through the export process, if preferred) and then transform the extracts into an easy-to-verify format—typically Excel or a pivot-ready CSV—flagging any mismatches or gaps along the way. Accuracy is critical because the GST department can reject a claim over the smallest inconsistency.

Deliverables  
• Consolidated dataset of Purchase Orders, Sales Invoices and Tax Payment Receipts, neatly separated by month and clearly linked to the relevant HSN/SAC codes.  
• A summary sheet that shows turnover, input tax credit accumulated due to inverted structure and the net refund figure, ready for RFD-01.  
• Brief reconciliation notes or exception log so I can answer officer queries without scrambling for source documents.

If you have prior experience extracting GST data from Tally and preparing refund claims, that will keep this project swift and smooth.

title: Excel Data Management Formula Support
desc:
I’m working on an Excel workbook that stores and organises large volumes of GST- and TDS-related figures. The structure is solid—data validation, filters, sorting and some conditional formatting are already in place—but the heart of the file, the formulas and functions, now need a careful audit and refinement to keep the data flow error-free as the sheet grows.

Here’s what I need from you:
• Go through every existing SUM, IF, nested IF, VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP I’ve built, check for hidden inconsistencies and remove any redundant calculations.  
• Optimise each formula so look-ups are fast and ranges stay dynamic even when new rows are added.  
• Confirm that all totals reconcile across summary tabs and the GST & TDS sections.  
• Return a final workbook that is fully tested, with clear notes or comments explaining any major changes you make.

If you can spot logic gaps quickly, love streamlining spreadsheets for reliable day-to-day data management, and can hand back a version that’s ready for submission without further tweaks, I’d like to hear how you’d tackle this.

title: Shaft Deflection & Stress Check
desc:
I need a quick, defensible sanity-check on a slowly rotating shaft that carries twelve discs and sits on two pillow-block bearings above a water tank. Once I send you the dimensioned drawing, material spec, disc weights, spacing, bearing positions and drive torque, please work out the following for two load cases—tank full and tank drained:

• mid-span deflection (location and magnitude)  
• maximum bending stress  
• resulting safety factor against yield (state the criterion you use)

Use whichever tool you prefer—ANSYS, SolidWorks, or any other package that produces reliable beam results. A short FEA is fine; a classical beam calculation that matches will give me extra confidence, so include enough detail (equations or screenshots) for me to replicate the numbers if I wish.

Deliverables (keep it to two pages):
1. A concise technical note in standard report style summarising assumptions, numbers, and a brief comment on which load case is worse.
2. One clear plot of bending moment, deflection or combined—whatever best shows the critical point—exported as PDF or PNG.

Send the native file only if it helps, otherwise the report is enough.

title: Exact PDF to Word Conversion
desc:
I have a digitally created PDF made up of text only, and I need the entire document retyped into Microsoft Word so the new file mirrors the original exactly. Every font choice, line break, paragraph indent, and spacing detail that appears in the PDF should look the same when I open the finished .docx.  

Because the source is a true digital PDF, you may copy and paste to speed things up, yet I still expect a careful proofread to catch stray line shifts, extra spaces, or dropped characters. Accuracy matters more than speed; I will be checking the Word file side by side with the PDF before I sign off.

Deliverable  
• One clean, error-free .docx that matches the PDF in text content and formatting 1:1.

title: Florida Architect Plan Review & Seal
desc:
I have a complete set of commercial office drawings that must go through a final sweep by a Florida-licensed architect or PE before I can submit them for permitting. The primary task is a detailed compliance review against the current Florida Building Code, with special attention to all fire-safety provisions—occupancy classification, egress paths, fire-rated assemblies, door hardware, alarms, sprinklers, and related notes. Compliance must specifically meet requirements for the city of Longwood.

Once any tweaks are identified, we can collaborate on them; after that, I need the full set signed and sealed (digital seal is fine under Florida statutes) so they are ready for the building department.

Deliverables:
• Written markup or redlined PDF highlighting every required code correction
• One clean, permit-ready drawing set bearing your Florida architectural or PE signature and seal (PDF; hard copies if the jurisdiction asks)

I can supply the current PDF the moment we agree. Let me know your turnaround time and confirm your Florida license to keep submittal questions to a minimum.

title: Exact PDF-to-Word Re-type
desc:
I have a PDF made up purely of text paragraphs that now needs to live in an editable Word file. Every heading, font size, alignment, bullet, and line break must look exactly the same as in the original PDF, because I still intend to do further edits once the conversion is complete.  

There are no images, tables, or graphics to worry about—just faithful, error-free text reproduction. Please deliver a clean .docx that mirrors the PDF page for page, ready for immediate editing.

title: Custom Elevator Cabin CAD Design
desc:
I need a full 3-D model and production drawings of a custom stainless-steel cabin for a commercial lift. You may work in SolidWorks (preferred) or another mainstream CAD platform, but the final files must open flawlessly in SolidWorks 2021.

I will supply shaft dimensions, door clearances, and load data; your job is to translate those into a complete cabin layout that integrates the following:

• Brushed stainless-steel cladding and trims  
• Ceiling-mounted lighting fixtures (specs will be provided or agreed with you)

Acceptance criteria  
• Native SolidWorks files (.sldprt, .sldasm) plus STEP export  
• 2-D shop drawings ready for laser cutting/bending  
• Bill of materials listing item code, quantity, material grade  
• All lighting and fan cut-outs positioned to the millimetre and cross-checked against the supplied specs  
• Model opens with no suppressed or missing features

If you have previous elevator or sheet-metal experience, let me see it—otherwise, similar precision metalwork is fine. I’m ready to start as soon as we agree on a timeline.

title: Sandblast & Paint Steel Trusses
desc:
I have ten structural steel trusses, each measuring 32 ft long by 7 ft high. I will arrange shipment of the individual trusses directly to your facility; all you need to do is receive them, sandblast to white metal, and apply an industrial-grade matte grey finish.

Scope of work  
• Full media blast to remove all mill scale, rust, and shop dirt  
• Application of a primer suited to exterior structural steel (please specify brand in your bid)  
• Two-coat matte grey topcoat, even coverage with no runs or thin spots  
• Adequate curing time, followed by protective wrap or other packaging for return freight

Acceptance criteria  
• Surface profile and cleanliness meet SSPC-SP 5 / NACE 1 or equivalent  
• Dry-film thickness complies with the paint manufacturer’s data sheet  
• No visible holidays, blistering, or discoloration under normal lighting

You’ll need the space and equipment to handle 32-ft members safely, along with appropriate blasting media, spray equipment, and environmental controls. When you reply, include the blasting media you prefer, the coating system you recommend, your estimated turnaround time per truss, and any certifications you hold for structural-steel coating work.

desc:
I have six separate parcels in Muskingum County, Ohio and I need their full chain-of-title reconstructed. I’m looking for more than a quick ownership check: every recorded deed, transfer, lien release, easement or other conveyance that touches these properties should be identified, starting with the earliest document on file and running right up to today.  

Your research will have to rely on the Muskingum County Recorder’s archives (online portals, in-office indexes or microfilm—whatever is required to reach the oldest book). Once located, I need clear digital copies of each instrument along with a concise, chronologically ordered summary of who conveyed to whom, the dates, instrument numbers and book/page references. If a gap appears in the timeline, note it so I can follow up.  

Deliverables  
• PDF (or high-resolution image) of every deed and related instrument you locate  
• A single spreadsheet or Word table that lists: recording date, grantor, grantee, instrument type, volume/page or document number, and a short notation of any restrictions or easements mentioned  
• Brief methodology note so I understand the sources you pulled and any records you could not access remotely  

Accuracy matters more than speed, but let me know your estimated turnaround and whether any courthouse visits or certified copies might add time. If you’ve handled Ohio title work before, please mention it so I can kick things off right away.

title: Bantuan Instalasi Windows & AI
desc:
Saya ingin pendampingan jarak jauh agar saya dapat menggunakan Microsoft Windows sekaligus memulai kerja dengan alat-alat AI.  

Ruang lingkup yang saya butuhkan:  
• Instalasi sistem operasi Microsoft Windows pada perangkat baru saya.  
• Pengaturan awal Windows—seperti akun, update, dan opsi keamanan dasar—agar sistem siap pakai.  
• Bimbingan instalasi serta konfigurasi awal platform AI pilihan saya (misalnya Python + pip, libraries machine learning, atau aplikasi AI desktop) sampai bisa dijalankan tanpa error.  

Harapan saya, Anda:  
– Menjelaskan setiap langkah secara jelas dalam bahasa Indonesia.  
– Memberikan panduan melalui video call atau remote-desktop agar proses berjalan cepat.  
– Menyediakan daftar singkat dependensi atau file yang perlu saya unduh terlebih dahulu.  

Saya menguasai dasar komputer, tetapi belum berpengalaman memasang OS maupun tool AI. Setelah sesi selesai, perangkat harus bisa boot ke Windows dengan lancar dan saya mampu membuka environment AI untuk eksperimen awal.

title: Part-Time Candidate Outreach Recruiter
desc:
I lead a fast-growing software team focused on AI training and need help sourcing new collaborators. Your core mission will be to find promising people, confirm their interest, and slot them into a meeting with us—roughly 5-10 hours of effort each week.

How you get there is flexible. Tap job boards, social media, professional networks, or any other avenue you trust; I’m open to whatever works. You can reach out by email, phone, social messages—again, the method is yours to choose. The only non-negotiable requirement in every candidate you bring me is reliability; solid, consistent follow-through matters more than anything else.

Here’s the flow I expect:
• Identify profiles that fit our basic brief (no technical background needed).
• Introduce our opportunity, gauge interest, confirm weekly availability.
• Schedule a Zoom or Google Meet between them and our team.

I pay a fixed fee for every confirmed meeting that meets those three checkpoints, and we’ll lock in the per-meeting rate together before kickoff.

When you respond, tell me about similar recruiting or outreach work you’ve handled, where you would look first for talent, and the per-meeting price you propose. Let’s see if our approaches line up and start filling the calendar.

title: Algorithmic Trading Website Development
desc:

Algorithmic trading website setup
Clean and responsive design
Trading strategy integration
Broker/API integration
User login and dashboard
Basic security and testing
Easy-to-manage backend

title: House Floor Plan and Elevation Drawing
desc:
I need a detailed architectural drawing of my house. The drawing should be in PDF format.

Requirements:
- Draw existing house floor plan and architectural elevation
- Detailed layout with measurements
- No existing plans or sketches provided

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Proficiency in architectural drawing
- Experience with CAD software
- Attention to detail and accuracy
